introHtml: Custom collared golf balls feature a distinctive neckline design that sets them apart on the green. Ideal for corporate tournaments, client gifts, or employee appreciation, these balls combine premium performance with personalized branding. Choose from top brands like Titleist and Volvik, available in various colors and customization options including imprinting your logo or message.
heroAltText: Custom collared golf balls with personalized logo imprint, featuring a collared neckline design, on a putting green.
